name: Accessibility Contract and Localization Architecture
description: Define the WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility contract and the localization/i18n architecture for Tribunus. Covers screen reader semantics, keyboard-first operation, reduced motion and contrast requirements, focus management, color contrast ratios, touch target sizes, and the locale system for translations, pluralization, RTL layout, and date/number formatting.
purpose: Establish a binding accessibility contract that enforces WCAG 2.2 AA compliance across all cockpit surfaces, and a localization architecture that supports multilingual deployments with minimal per-locale overhead.
acceptanceCriteria: WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility contract defines success criteria per component (navigation, editor, agent panels, dialogs, notifications)
Keyboard-first operation specification includes focus order, skip links, keyboard shortcuts, and focus indicators
Screen reader semantics specification covers ARIA roles, live regions, announcements, and alternative text patterns
Reduced motion and high contrast modes are specified with implementation guidance
Localization architecture document defines locale resolution, translation file format, pluralization rules, date/number formatting, and RTL layout strategy
